Messages.Author: Walter Klust
Messages.Body:
If I play the Dramatic Upheaval as political action, choose my prey for
switching places and if finally the vote will be successful (phew):
who is the next Methuselah to act, after I have finished my Turn?
For Illustration the sitting order:
Before: Me--Him--You; After vote: Him--Me--You
I Think the next Methuselah is "You", so that my poor ex-prey losses his
turn.
Is that correct ?

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
eise...@cs.tu-berlin.de (Walter Klust) writes:



Turn passes to the left, so yes - your ex-prey new-predator will be
a while in taking his/her turn (doesn't *exactly* lose a turn, but it's
close!)

Messages.Author: Judas Iscariot
Messages.Body:



Yes, you are correct sir! YES.
